periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Inventoried behavioral, dental and primary care providers across the city and chose filters for insurance, language and walk-in hours. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Build the combined listing and ask providers to review their entries.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Built a draft combined care listing and sent entries to providers for review. Drafted a tear-off wayfinding map. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Launch the listing, verify every entry by phone in July, and post the tear-off map at clinics and libraries.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Launched a combined care listing with filters for insurance, language and walk-in hours, and posted a tear-off map at clinics and libraries. Providers verified their entries by phone in July. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Verify listings again in November, add Spanish and Tagalog versions, and train 211 operators.
